# Code of Conduct

Peony follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind, assume good intent, and keep discussion about the work. Harassment, personal attacks, and publishing someone's private information are not welcome here, in issues, pull requests, or anywhere else the project is discussed.

## Reporting

If someone's behavior makes this project a worse place to be, tell the maintainer privately through the contact details on [pungrumpy.com](https://www.pungrumpy.com). Reports are kept confidential.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may remove comments, close issues, or block accounts that break this code, and will say why when it's reasonable to.
